# Open Educational Resources / Open Source Physics @ Singapore

> A comprehensive platform of interactive simulations and open educational resources aligned with Singapore's MOE EdTech Masterplan, spanning physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, languages, and humanities.

OER@SG and OSP@SG are innovation initiatives under Singapore's Ministry of Education that provide free, interactive learning tools developed by educators like Loo Kang Wee. The platform leverages HTML5 and JavaScript to deliver engaging digital learning experiences across multiple subject areas for students and teachers.

## Getting Started

- [Home - Open Educational Resources / Open Source Physics @ Singapore](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg): Homepage for OER@SG and OSP@SG innovation initiatives under MOE's EdTech Masterplan
- [Interactive Resources Directory](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources): Main directory of interactive educational resources across physics, chemistry, biology, and more

## Science & Mathematics Resources

- [Physics](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/physics): Physics simulations including projectile motion and wave physics by Loo Kang Wee
- [Chemistry](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/chemistry): Chemistry interactive resources including acid-base titration and virtual experiments
- [Biology](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/biology): Biology simulations covering photosynthesis, ecology, and ecosystem exploration
- [Mathematics](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/mathematics): Mathematics resources using Geogebra, Geometer Sketchpad, and virtual manipulatives
- [Sciences](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/sciences): Sciences resources including K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm visualization and machine learning

## Language & Humanities Resources

- [English Language](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/english): English language interactive tools for story sequencing and literary analysis
- [Mother Tongue Languages](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/mother-tongue-languages): Mother tongue language resources including Malay and Chinese language learning tools
- [Humanities](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/humanities): Humanities interactive resources for historical and geographical exploration

## Arts, Sports & Character Education

- [Arts](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/arts): Arts interactive tools including kaleidoscope simulators and creative coding resources
- [Physical & Sports Education](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/physical-sports-education): Physical education simulations covering projectile motion, Magnus force, and sports dynamics
- [Character & Citizenship Education](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/character-citizenship-education): Character and citizenship education interactive resources aligned with Singapore curriculum

## Teaching & Learning Tools

- [Formative Assessment Tools](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/teaching-resources): Guide to formative assessment tools including Slido, Kahoot, Plickers, and Socrative
- [How-To Guides](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/translations): How-to guides for translations, video creation, SSL certificates, and Docker deployment

## Research & Projects

- [Publications](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/research): Publications and research by Loo Kang Wee on interactive simulations and physics education
- [Research Projects](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/projects): Research projects including digital simulation, metacognition, and LTI integration
- [Events](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/events): Events calendar featuring workshops, professional development, and mentorship opportunities

## Other Resources

- [Others](https://sg.iwant2study.org/ospsg/index.php/interactive-resources/others): Miscellaneous interactive resources for accounting, business, and other subjects
